content.html: Laban is a digital compass app developed by Google AI. We prioritize your privacy and are committed to protecting user data.
The Laban app collects the following types of data to operate core features:

items: Device sensor data (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer) to determine direction and movement.

content.html: We use the data to provide features such as:

items: Displaying sensor data such as magnetic field strength and GPS satellite coordinates.
Enhancing user experience with Material Design.

content.html: The app requires the following permissions:

items: Location: To display GPS coordinates and satellite information.
Device Sensors: To detect device direction and movement to rotate the compass.
